featured_snippet_target: A short, direct answer to 'why does an AI coding tool invent a method that doesn't exist?' — 2-3 sentences: it is a probabilistic next-token predictor pattern-matching against similar real APIs, with no ability to check whether the method actually exists, and it expresses guesses with the same confidence as facts.
